name: Responses API — Inline moderation
summary: Nested `moderation.model` field on POST /v1/responses (and POST /v1/chat/completions) that runs a separate moderation model alongside the main generation.
description: The Responses and Chat Completions APIs accept an inline `moderation` block whose `moderation.model` field names a dedicated moderation model (e.g. `omni-moderation-latest`) executed against the request/response in the same call as the mainline `model`. This is a **second, nested `model` slot** on the same request. Untested whether the Foundry data plane / APIM connection preserves the nested field when the mainline `model` uses the BYOM `{connection}/{deployment}` prefix — the concern is that the gateway strips or ignores the nested field on the way through.
notes: Status-only. If confirmed working, promote to `supported`; if the nested `moderation.model` is dropped or forced back onto the Foundry account, mark `not_supported`.
